items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: one of the most famous golf pros in the history of golf, whose name incidently was the same as mine... his name was Jimmy Thomson

ctx.x: Now, I would have to say it was a combination of this that led me up into those mountains where it was Broadmoor, Colorado, where they had a country club. And one of the most famous golf pros in the history of golf, whose name incidently was the same as mine with the exception of the spelling -- his name was Jimmy Thomson, he spelled his T-h-o-m-s-o-n, I believe he was Irish. And would you believe it, there's supposed to be Irish in my family.
